long_biography.plain_text:
Raye Gillis White entered business after studying at Durham Business College and working for Anderson Clayton. In 1958 she joined Fayez Sarofim as he established an independent Houston investment firm, beginning a professional association that would span nearly seven decades. White advanced from early support responsibilities to executive vice president, director, compliance leader and member of the firm’s executive and investment committees.

Across the Sarofim advisory, trust, international-management and real-estate affiliates, White has held senior governance and compliance posts. Her Chartered Investment Counselor credential and committee work place investment management, rather than mere administration, at the centre of her career. Beyond the firm, White served the Hermann Eye Fund and became a lifetime director of the University of St. Thomas and Christus Health. She also sits on the Sarofim Foundation board.
